text:
Maya: Hey team — dropped a Figma frame for toast dismiss behavior. Prototype currently shifts focus to the primary action after a toast is dismissed and you can see a quick focus flash when people close it with the keyboard. screenshot: https://figma.com/file/abc123 (see top-right toasts) Kevin: I noticed that too in the demo. We shouldn't reorder DOM or move focus unless the user explicitly interacts. Maybe render toasts in a portal and keep them out of the document flow. Ria: Accessibility note: toasts should be announced via ARIA live regions, not by forcing focus. Use role="status" and aria-live="polite" so screen readers pick it up without stealing keyboard focus. Ria: Example markup suggestion: ```
\n Saved\n
``` David: Another real issue: `Esc` is wired globally to close toasts and also closes modals in our demo flow. During the product walkthrough modal kept closing when people were trying to dismiss toasts — bad UX. Maya: Good call. Can we scope `Esc` to only close a toast when the toast or one of its interactive children currently has focus? Or when a toast is hovered? That avoids conflicting with modal handlers. Kevin: Yeah scope the handler or register it on the toast element and stopPropagation. Also prefer making dismiss a pointer affordance by default; keyboard users can still tab to actions but we shouldn't auto-focus. Ria: Copy and timing thoughts: some toasts are actionable (eg. "Upload failed — Retry"). Actionable toasts probably need longer timeout or persistent until dismissed. Non-actionable ones can be 4s. Also shorten copy where possible: use "Saved" or "Copied" instead of long sentences. Maya: Let's A/B test 4s vs 8s for actionable toasts. For errors, mark them persistent until user dismisses. I'll update the figma with both timings and a persistent state. David: Implementation note: put toasts in an absolutely positioned container (top-right) so they don't cause layout shifts. Add support for `prefers-reduced-motion` to remove slide/flash animations for those users. Kevin: I'll open a PR to: 1) move toasts to portal container, 2) change live region to role=status, 3) remove autofocus on dismiss, 4) scope Esc handler. ETA EOD. design-bot: deploy preview updated: https://deploy.preview/xyz — shows portal + behavior tweak :rocket: Maya: Thanks! I'll adjust copy variants and show both timing options in the updated prototype. Ria — can you drop a short a11y QA checklist here when you have a minute? Ria: Sure — will post checklist and a few NVDA/VoiceOver notes tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:
